title: Plan: Rise/Set, Eclipses, Occultations
description:
Port the largest chunk of swecl.c (~4000 lines). Atmospheric refraction, horizontal coordinates, rise/set/transit, solar and lunar eclipses, occultations.

## Refraction (swecl.c:3035, catalogue-internal §11)
- `swe_refrac(inalt, atpress, attemp, calc_flag)` — Saemundsson formula (>17.9°) + low-altitude polynomial
- `swe_refrac_extended(inalt, geoalt, atpress, attemp, lapse_rate, calc_flag, dret)` — elevated observers, geometric horizon dip

## Horizontal coordinates (catalogue-internal §6.3)
- `swe_azalt(tjd_ut, calc_flag, geopos, atpress, attemp, xin, xaz)` — ecliptic/equatorial → azimuth/altitude with refraction
- `swe_azalt_rev()` — inverse

## Rise/Set (catalogue-internal §10)
**Fast algorithm** (swecl.c:4203): |lat| ≤ 60°, semi-diurnal arc estimate, 2-4 Newton iterations
**Full algorithm** (swecl.c:4387): sample 14-15 points at 2hr intervals, find zero crossings, binary search refinement (20 iterations → ~86μs accuracy)
**Meridian transit** (swecl.c:4688): 4-iteration RA matching, 361°/day rate
**Circumpolar detection**: arccos argument out of [-1,1] range

## Solar eclipses (catalogue-internal §9)
**Global search** (swecl.c:1185): Meeus lunation stepping, F-argument filter (eliminates ~70%), approximate max time, iterative refinement via find_maximum()
**Shadow geometry** (swecl.c:640): shadow axis direction, umbra/penumbra half-angles, shadow cone intersection with Earth
**Local circumstances** (swecl.c:967): topocentric positions, magnitude = (-dctr + rsun + rmoon)/(2×rsun), obscuration from circular segment intersection
**Contact times**: find_zero() with 2hr initial sampling, 3 refinement iterations

## Lunar eclipses (catalogue-internal §9.4)
Shadow cone from selenocentric perspective. Atmospheric correction factors (1+1/50, ×0.99405/0.98813 for NASA agreement).

## Occultations
Same machinery as solar eclipses but for Moon covering planet/star.

## Rust design
These functions need `&mut Ephemeris` because they call `calc()` internally. Group as methods:
```rust
impl Ephemeris {
    pub fn rise_trans(&mut self, ...) -> Result<RiseSetResult, Error> { ... }
    pub fn solar_eclipse_when_global(&mut self, ...) -> Result<EclipseGlobal, Error> { ... }
    pub fn solar_eclipse_how(&mut self, ...) -> Result<EclipseLocal, Error> { ... }
    // etc.
}
```

## Testing
- setest/suite_08_eclipses.c, setest/suite_09_rise.c
- Golden data: known historical eclipses, sunrise/sunset for various locations and dates
- Circumpolar edge cases: Tromsø in summer/winter

## C source reference
- swecl.c:640 — eclipse_where (shadow geometry)
- swecl.c:967 — eclipse_how (local circumstances)
- swecl.c:1185 — swe_sol_eclipse_when_glob (Meeus search)
- swecl.c:3035 — swe_refrac, swe_refrac_extended
- swecl.c:3237 — lun_eclipse_how
- swecl.c:4203 — rise_set_fast
- swecl.c:4387 — swe_rise_trans_true_hor (full algorithm)
- swecl.c:4688 — meridian transit

## Dependencies
- Phase 5 (calc pipeline — this calls calc() heavily), Phase 3 (sidereal time for azalt)
execution_record:
Decomposed into 12 implement-phase sub-tasks (swisseph-rs/68-79), each a self-contained single-session Sonnet brief with exact ref-doc citations, signatures, golden-test specs, and escape hatches. Six C reference docs written by dedicated sonnet agents (committed c3b61bd): c-ref-topocentric, -refraction-azalt, -riseset, -eclipse-solar, -eclipse-lunar, -occultation.

Divergences from the original description:
1. STALE ARCHITECTURE: original said these functions need `&mut Ephemeris`. Corrected to stateless `&self` throughout (matches calc/houses_ex2). No swe_set_topo / swe_set_lapse_rate globals — observer comes from config.topographic, lapse_rate is an explicit parameter.
2. HIDDEN PREREQUISITE (not in original): topocentric swe_calc support. Rust calc() currently rejects SEFLG_TOPOCTR with UnsupportedFlags, but rise/set (swe_calc_ut|TOPOCTR) AND every eclipse _where/_how/_loc depend on it (verified via swecl.c grep: lines 385,414,1551,1868 + rise range 4230,4297). So swi_get_observer + the TOPOCTR branches in sweph.c's app_pos code (~2524-2586,3395-3531,3923-3971) had to be added as RSE 1/12 — the gating dependency. Conceptually a Phase-5 (calc pipeline) concern that was missed; owned here because no other arc covers it.
3. Only refraction+azalt (RSE 2) are independent of topocentric calc; everything else chains off RSE 1.
4. Sub-task boundaries follow the C function map (swecl.c 565-5063 minus swe_pheno/nod_aps/orbital/gauquelin which belong to swisseph-rs/13): topo → azalt → riseset(full+transit / fast) → solar eclipse(where / how / when_glob / when_loc) → lunar eclipse(how / when) → occultation(where+glob / when_loc). find_maximum/find_zero go into math.rs (RSE 3), reused by all search tasks. EclipseFlags/RiseSetFlags already existed in flags.rs.
5. Corrected a factual error from the original description: rise/set bisection resolution is ~7 ms, not "86µs" (per c-ref-riseset.md §5.4, traced from source).

Dependency graph wired via depends_on edges; all 12 refine swisseph-rs/12. Arc 019efa3c advanced study→implement.
